title: ""Tips of the Trade"" doc page contains a link to an external blog containing offensive content
description: The link is present on these pages:    https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA040/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA041/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA042/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA043/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA044/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA050/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA051/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA052/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA060/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA061/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA062/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA063/Tips+of+the+Trade  https://confluence.atlassian.com/display/JIRA064/Tips+of+the+Trade    The offending link is entitled """"Git branches to handle contributor patches"""" and links to a page on the site http://jpz-log.info    The link probably had relevant content at some point but the external site appears to have been compromised - with the attacker replacing the original content with NSFW content.    We should remove this link in order to deprive the attacker of SEO ranking, and also disassociate our docs with this content.

title: Update the Mail Handler documentation on what is considered a bulk message
description: h3. Problem Definition    Thanks to the fix fo JRASERVER-38662, the following conditions that incoming mails are considered as """"bulk"""" have been covered in the corresponding section [in the latest document|https://confluence.atlassian.com/adminjiraserver/creating-issues-and-comments-from-email-938847641.html#Creatingissuesandcommentsfromemail-Createanewissueoraddacommenttoanexistingissue] for now.    * The first 'Precedence' header in the message is 'bulk'  * The message contains the header """"Auto-Submitted"""" with a value different than """"no""""    However, the following conditions still aren't mentioned.    * The message is a """"multipart/report"""" message and the content type contains 'report-type=delivery-status'  * The message is not a """"multipart/report"""" message and the """"Return-Path"""" is """"<>""""    h3. Suggested Solution    It would be better to mention the conditions in the document as well.
